# bioexcel/biobb_cmip/cmip_run

## Summary

Wrapper class for the CMIP cmip module.

The CMIP cmip module. CMIP cmip module compute classical molecular interaction potentials.

Nextflow adapter of the [CmipRun](https://biobb-cmip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cmip.html#module-cmip.cmip_run) building block of [biobb_cmip](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_cmip) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CMIP_CMIP_RUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_cmip/cmip_run'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CMIP_CMIP_RUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input PDB file |
| `input_probe_pdb_path` | no | pdb | Path to the input probe file in PDB format |
| `input_rst_path` | no | txt | Path to the input restart file |
| `input_vdw_params_path` | no | txt | Path to the CMIP input Van der Waals force parameters, if not provided the CMIP conda installation one is used ("$CONDA_PREFIX/share/cmip/dat/vdwprm") |
| `input_params_path` | no | txt | Path to the CMIP input parameters file |
| `input_json_box_path` | no | json | Path to the input CMIP box in JSON format |
| `input_json_external_box_path` | no | json | Path to the input CMIP box in JSON format |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | no, opt-in | pdb | Path to the output PDB file |
| `output_grd_path` | no, opt-in | grd | Path to the output grid file in GRD format |
| `output_cube_path` | no, opt-in | cube | Path to the output grid file in cube format |
| `output_rst_path` | no, opt-in | txt | Path to the output restart file |
| `output_byat_path` | no, opt-in | txt, out | Path to the output atom by atom energy file |
| `output_log_path` | no, opt-in | log | Path to the output CMIP log file LOG |
| `output_json_box_path` | no, opt-in | json | Path to the output CMIP box in JSON format |
| `output_json_external_box_path` | no, opt-in | json | Path to the output external CMIP box in JSON format |
| `versions_biobb_cmip` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_cmip', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of CmipRun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_cmip container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CMIP_CMIP_RUN' {
        ext.properties = [execution_type: 'check_only']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `execution_type` | string | "mip_pos" | Default options for the params file, each one creates a different params file. Values: check_only, mip_pos, mip_neg, mip_neu, solvation, pb_interaction_energy, docking, docking_rst. |
| `params` | object | {} | CMIP options specification. |
| `binary_path` | string | "cmip" | Path to the CMIP cmip executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
